summary: ansible.netcommon's in-collection paramiko support for network_cli (ssh_type=paramiko) is deprecated for removal after 2028-02-01; switch to ssh_type=libssh with ansible-pylibssh.
questions: Should I use paramiko or libssh with network_cli?
How do I switch network_cli to libssh?

answer_card.title: network_cli paramiko layer deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
`network_cli` includes a paramiko compatibility layer (used when `ssh_type` is `paramiko`) for environments without ansible-core's paramiko connection. It is deprecated and will be removed after **2028-02-01**. Install `ansible-pylibssh` and set `ssh_type=libssh`:

```bash
pip install ansible-pylibssh
```
